mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_reports (str_id, source_id, report_content, qr_code_path, dify_message_id, keywords, is_published, generated_at) VALUES (#{strId}, #{sourceId}, #{reportContent}, #{qrCodePath}, #{difyMessageId}, #{keywords}, #{isPublished}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, str_id, user_id, dify_conversation_id, source_name, source_type, description FROM water_sources WHERE str_id = #{sourceStrId} AND is_active = 1

SELECT r.id, r.str_id, r.source_id, r.report_content, r.qr_code_path, r.generated_at, r.is_published, r.dify_message_id, r.keywords, s.source_name,s.source_type, s.str_id AS sourceStrId, u.username FROM analysis_reports r JOIN water_sources s ON r.source_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE r.str_id = #{reportStrId} AND s.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.str_id, r.report_content, r.qr_code_path, r.generated_at, r.keywords,
s.source_name AS sourceName, s.source_type AS sourceType
FROM analysis_reports r LEFT JOIN water_sources s ON r.source_id = s.id WHERE r.str_id = #{reportStrId} AND r.is_published = 1

SELECT wqd.id, wqd.str_id, wqd.turbidity_value, wqd.unit, wqd.measured_at FROM water_quality_data wqd JOIN report_data_links rdl ON wqd.id = rdl.data_id WHERE rdl.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY wqd.measured_at ASC
